STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Collection item created. No outreach actioned yet.
NOTES: Initial status when agent creates a collection item.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Outreach active. Collector assigned. Follow-up scheduled.
NOTES: Set by agent when CFO confirms collection action.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Customer has confirmed a specific payment date.
NOTES: Set when PROMISE_TO_PAY_DATE is recorded and confirmed by customer.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Invoice linked to an open dispute case. Payment withheld pending resolution.
NOTES: Set concurrently with FSCM Dispute Management case creation.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Payment received or case resolved (written off / dispute settled).
NOTES: Set by agent on payment confirmation detection. Triggers AR clearing.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Dispute case raised. Under investigation.
NOTES: Created via UDM_DISPUTE T-code.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Evidence being gathered. Owner assigned.
Company accepted customer's dispute claim. Credit memo to be raised.
NOTES: Requires CFO authorisation before credit memo (FB75) is posted.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Counter-evidence submitted. Customer must pay in full.
NOTES: Triggers formal counter-claim process.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Dispute fully resolved and AR cleared.
Pre-litigation hold created. Monitoring active. Not yet escalated.
NOTES: Agent can create holds in DORMANT status only. @LegalTeam owns status transitions.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Legal proceedings initiated. @LegalTeam in control.
NOTES: AGENT CANNOT SET THIS STATUS. @LegalTeam only.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Case passed to external legal firm.
NOTES: @LegalTeam only.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: WorkItem sent to approver. Awaiting response.
NOTES: Agent creates WorkItem. Human approves in SAP inbox or Teams.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Approver confirmed action. Agent proceeds to execution.
NOTES: Agent watches for this status to trigger next execution step.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Approver declined. Action blocked.
NOTES: Agent surfaces rejection in War Room and requests alternative instruction.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Outbound delivery blocked due to credit hold.
NOTES: Applied via VL02N at delivery header level. Removes when @RaviKumar releases via VKM1.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: No credit blocks. Trading within terms.
NOTES: Normal operating state.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Credit limit or risk category under reassessment.
NOTES: Agent sets this when escalation initiated.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Credit limit set to $0. No new SOs accepted.
NOTES: Agent stages; human confirms in VKM1 / FD32.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: No dunning notice issued. Invoice within terms or newly overdue.
Automated first reminder. Friendly tone.
NOTES: Triggered at 15d overdue per ZAR01 procedure.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Escalated chase. Reference to potential consequences.
NOTES: Triggered at 30d overdue.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Formal final notice before legal. Registered post.
NOTES: Triggered at 45d overdue.

STATUS_DESCRIPTION: Demand letter. CFO authorisation required. Interest accrues.
NOTES: Triggered at 90d overdue. Agent proposes; CFO must authorise via approval workflow.
